### 📌 Tips for Spotting the Moon in Bright Daylight:

5. **Wait a bit** — as the Sun sets, the sky will darken, and the Moon will become easier to see.

---

### 📆 Time to Wait

If you're still in daylight, you might want to **wait until the Sun sets** (around 5:10 PM PST in Davis on December 31, 2026), at which point the sky will darken, and the Moon will become more visible.
